info.title: v2.logistics.get_channel_list
info.description: Use this api to get all supported logistic channels.

get.description: Use this api to get all supported logistic channels.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_channel_list?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: logistics_description
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: For checkout channels, this field indicates its corresponding fulfillment channels.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: force_enable
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicates whether the logistic channel is force enabled on Shop Level. If true, sellers cannot close this channel.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: mask_channel_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate the parent logistic channel ID. If it’s 0, it indicates the channel is a checkout(masked) channel; if it’s not 0, indicate the channel is a fulfillment channel and has a checkout channel(checkout channel’s channel_id equals this mask_channel_id) on top of it. Multiple channels may share the same mask_channel_id.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: block_seller_cover_shipping_fee
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate whether the channel is blocked to use seller cover shipping fee function. if the channel does not allow sellers to cover shipping fee, then the block_seller_cover_shipping_fee field will return true, otherwise it will return false.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: support_cross_border
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate whether this channel support cross border shipping.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: seller_logistic_has_configuration
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate If seller has set the Seller logistics configuration if set will return true, otherwise it will return false or null.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: logistics_capability
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The capability of one logistic channel.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: seller_logistics
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate If it's a Seller logistics channel, if it's a Seller logistics channel will return true, otherwise it will return false.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: preprint
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate whether this channel support pre-print AWB

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: service_type_identifier
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This parameter specifies the delivery service type of logistics channel. Applicable values: - instant - same_day - null

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: auto_call_driver_eligible
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate whether this channel is eligible for Auto Call Driver.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: auto_call_driver_enabled
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate whether Auto Call Driver is currently enabled for this channel

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: preparation_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The current valid preparation time for this channel, in minutes.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: preparation_time_limit
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The preparation time range allowed for this channel. Note: When calling v2.logistics.update_channel to set the Preparation Time for the channel, the time must not exceed this range.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: min_preparation_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The minimum allowable preparation time, in minutes.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: max_preparation_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The maximum allowable preparation time, in minutes.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: support_pause
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicates whether this channel supports the pause operation (Pausing allows the shop to temporarily prevent buyers from placing orders through this logistics channel). - true: This channel is affected by the pause function. - false: This channel is not affected by the pause function. Note: Please first call v2.logistics.get_pause_status to get the current pause status of logistics channels under the shop. If is_paused = true, then call v2.logistics.get_channel_list and identify the range of channels affected by the pause function through support_pause = true.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: compulsory_channel
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicates if the channel is compulsory. If the value is true, at least one such channel must be enabled.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: channel_relation_rules
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate the related rules & channels of this logistic channel.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: related_enabled_channels
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Channels that will be auto-enabled in the same request if this channel is enabled.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: related_dependent_block_channels
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Channels that must be disabled before or while disabling this parent channel.
